title: Azure Firewall Event Hub field schema catalogue
group_label_interpretation: Wildcard group, not an additional diagnostic category. Expanded into the 13 individually listed AZFW categories.
scope: Three legacy diagnostic categories and 13 structured categories. Full public table column dictionaries are retained for the structured categories, with Log Analytics standard columns separated.
